styles.container: max-width: 740px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8 !important; color: #3f3f3f !important; word-wrap: break-word; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff6b35 0%, #f7931e 50%, #ffb347 100%) !important;;
styles.blockquote: margin: 16px 0; padding: 10px 16px; background-color: #fafafa !important; border-left: 3px solid #999; color: #666 !important; line-height: 1.6 !important;
styles.code: font-family: Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 6px; background-color: #f5f5f5 !important; color: #e74c3c !important; border-radius: 3px;
styles.pre: margin: 20px 0; padding: 16px; background-color: #2d2d2d !important; border-radius: 8px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6 !important;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; max-height: 600px !important; height: auto; display: block; margin: 20px auto; border-radius: 8px;
styles.th: background-color: #f0f0f0 !important; padding: 10px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; font-weight: 600;
